prompt.project_info: Create a professional social-media-ready tropical beach vacation photograph with a relaxed, serene travel-editorial mood.
prompt.main_subject: An adult blonde woman with long, loose, slightly windswept hair and a white tropical flower tucked behind one ear. She has light sun-kissed skin, a slim athletic build, natural makeup, and a calm, slightly contemplative expression while looking toward the horizon. She wears a blue, yellow, and white floral triangle bikini with tie-side bottoms and is barefoot.
prompt.composition_elements: White sandy shoreline, turquoise ocean with gentle waves, clear blue sky, two small rocky islands on the horizon, and distant beachgoers walking and swimming. Seat the subject on the sand with legs bent to the side, one hand behind her for support and the other touching her neck. Use a medium-full-body vertical frame, slightly low to eye level, rule-of-thirds placement, sharp subject focus, and a moderately softened background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural overhead sunlight angled slightly across the scene, soft shadows, bright blue and turquoise palette, warm sand beige and yellow accents, relaxed summery vacation atmosphere with high clarity.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical 9:16 composition, travel photography and candid lifestyle aesthetic, natural skin and fabric texture, moderate depth of field, clear professional social-media-ready detail, natural perspective without wide-angle distortion.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Tropical beach during daytime, white sandy shoreline with turquoise ocean water and gentle waves, clear blue sky, two small rocky islands visible on the horizon, and several distant beachgoers. An adult blonde woman with long loose slightly windswept hair and a white tropical flower behind one ear sits on the sand with legs bent to the side, one hand resting behind her for support and the other touching her neck, looking slightly off-camera toward the horizon with a calm, neutral, contemplative expression. She has light sun-kissed skin, natural makeup, and wears a blue, yellow, and white floral triangle bikini with tie-side bottoms, barefoot. Natural sunlight, soft shadows, bright saturated coastal colors, medium-full-body vertical travel-lifestyle photograph, rule-of-thirds composition, moderate depth of field, sharp subject focus, relaxed confident carefree summer mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, blurry, low quality, distorted features, bad anatomy, cartoon, illustration, grainy, pixelated, extra limbs, extra fingers, deformed, watermark

assets.name: adult beach subject
assets.usage: Preserve the adult subject's face, hair, pose, proportions, and relaxed expression; replaceable with another approved adult.

assets.name: blue-yellow-white floral bikini
assets.usage: Keep the floral pattern, triangle-top construction, tie-side bottoms, and white flower accessory consistent; replaceable as a coordinated swimwear reference.

assets.name: tropical beach and rocky-island horizon
assets.usage: Preserve the white sand, turquoise water, islands, sky, and distant beach activity; environment may be replaced while retaining tropical vacation hierarchy.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the matching preview when exact subject, outfit, and environment consistency is required. Keep adult identity, floral swimwear, flower accessory, beach horizon, and vertical composition consistent. The person, wardrobe, and location can each be replaced independently only when the replacement preserves the same visual hierarchy; do not introduce logos or typography.
